title: dependency risk
summary: Before introducing a new external crate, review its necessity, license compatibility, maintenance/security posture and operational cost; record exceptions relevant to the project's authorized scope.

rationale: Independent new-Rust-project dependencies obligation identified by the scoped coverage audit. Generic build, CI and MVP rules remain authoritative and are not duplicated here.

exceptions: Excluded or inapplicable capabilities do not require invented implementation tasks; verified deviations and untested paths must remain disclosed.
